title: NovaCorp Compensation Bands by Level (FY2025)
content:
NovaCorp Compensation Framework — FY2025 CONFIDENTIAL
For HR Use Only — Distribution Restricted

SALARY BANDS BY LEVEL

Level L1 — Associate
Base Salary Range: $55,000 to $72,000
Target Bonus: 5% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $5,000 to $10,000 (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)

Level L2 — Analyst / Engineer II
Base Salary Range: $72,000 to $95,000
Target Bonus: 8% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $10,000 to $25,000 (4-year vest)

Level L3 — Senior Analyst / Senior Engineer
Base Salary Range: $95,000 to $130,000
Target Bonus: 12% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $25,000 to $50,000 (4-year vest)

Level L4 — Lead / Staff Engineer
Base Salary Range: $130,000 to $175,000
Target Bonus: 15% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $50,000 to $100,000 (4-year vest)

Level L5 — Principal / Senior Staff
Base Salary Range: $175,000 to $230,000
Target Bonus: 20% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $100,000 to $200,000 (4-year vest)

Level L6 — Director
Base Salary Range: $230,000 to $310,000
Target Bonus: 25% of base
Equity Grant: RSUs valued at $200,000 to $400,000 (4-year vest)

Level L7 — VP and Above
Base Salary Range: $310,000 and above (individually negotiated)
Target Bonus: 30% to 50% of base
Equity Grant: $500,000 and above (individually negotiated)

MID-YEAR REVIEW GUIDELINES
Salary adjustments outside bands require CHRO approval. Market adjustments for retention are evaluated annually. Equity refresh grants are reviewed at performance reviews.

This document is classified CONFIDENTIAL. Unauthorized disclosure constitutes a violation of NovaCorp's Code of Conduct.
